mode: Saved-file JSON inspection, exact integer ratio arithmetic, SHA-256 hashing, and read-only Git blob comparison; no project modules loaded, scientific execution, reproduction, tests, or live process probing.

publicationReceipt.transport: Separate exact-commit raw.githubusercontent.com HTTPS manifest download; curl TLS verification enabled; every pin checked against local and committed bytes. No connector claim.

limits: Numerical reference/model operations and mutation controls were not rerun; their reported outcomes are inspected and byte-bound.

Execution-context labels are caller attestations. Parent reports both actual dispatches used require_escalated; external dispatch records were not independently inspected.
Closure is saved sampled process-group evidence, not a new live absence check, continuous RSS peak proof, or hostile escape isolation.
Private raw log locations and runtime executable bytes were not opened; saved declarations and published logs were inspected.
